svg.aria-label: Under the hood: one Next.js 16 app on Vercel or Docker. The GitHub App (sign-in, issues, webhooks, checks, comments and test pull requests), alerts and tickets (Sentry, PagerDuty and seven more sources in Labs), the browser, the CLI and GitHub Action (/api/v1) and coding agents (MCP at /api/mcp) all talk to it. Inside: app/(site) and app/(app) pages, app/api/webhooks, app/api/v1 and app/api/mcp, lib/workflows (time travel, PR check, Epicenter and nightly, on Vercel Workflow) and lib/domain (pure, unit-tested verdict logic). It uses Postgres (Neon on Vercel, embedded PGlite locally and self-hosted), a runner (a Vercel Sandbox microVM or Docker, network cut before tests, no secrets) and a model provider (Muse, Vercel AI Gateway or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM.

g.text: VERCEL + NEON, OR ONE MACHINE WITH DOCKER COMPOSE
the app and the public site
public site, docs and the product; server actions
GitHub and every alert source, signature-verified
HTTP API, CLI and the MCP server
time travel, PR check, Epicenter, nightly; Vercel Workflow
verdicts, admission, relevance: pure and unit-tested
Neon on Vercel; embedded PGlite locally
network cut before tests, no secrets
Muse, Vercel AI Gateway or any
Keys and webhook secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Runners clone with read-only, single-repository tokens. Nothing is pushed to a default branch.
